en.line: Your Azure bill depends on what you use, how much, where, and how you buy it.
en.simple: Six things affect cost: the resource type and its settings, how you consume it (pay-as-you-go or a commitment), maintenance (leftover resources still cost money), geography (prices differ by region), your subscription type, and Azure Marketplace products. Data coming into Azure is often free, while data going out is charged by billing zone.
en.africa: Sending goods into a market is often free, but taking goods out across the border costs a fee. Leaving a rented stall full of unused stock still costs rent. Cloud costs work the same way.
en.breaks: A billing zone is only for data-transfer pricing. It is not an availability zone.
en.exam: Which does NOT affect cost? The number of resource groups, or inbound data. Resource groups and tags are free.

check.q: Which of these does NOT add cost on its own?
check.why: Resource groups, management groups and tags are free.

sw.line: Bili yako ya Azure inategemea unachotumia, kiasi gani, wapi, na jinsi unavyokinunua.
sw.simple: Mambo sita yanaathiri gharama: aina ya rasilimali na mipangilio yake, jinsi unavyoitumia (pay-as-you-go au ahadi), matengenezo (rasilimali zilizobaki bado zinagharimu), jiografia (bei hutofautiana kwa eneo), aina ya subscription yako, na bidhaa za Azure Marketplace. Data inayoingia Azure mara nyingi ni bure, wakati data inayotoka inalipiwa kwa billing zone.
sw.africa: Kuingiza bidhaa sokoni mara nyingi ni bure, lakini kuzitoa nje ya mpaka kunalipiwa ada. Kuacha kibanda ulichokodi kimejaa bidhaa zisizotumika bado kunagharimu kodi. Gharama za wingu hufanya kazi vivyo hivyo.
sw.breaks: Billing zone ni kwa bei ya kuhamisha data tu. Si availability zone.
sw.exam: Kipi HAKIATHIRI gharama? Idadi ya resource groups, au data inayoingia. Resource groups na tags ni bure.

check.q: Kipi kati ya hivi HAKIONGEZI gharama peke yake?
check.why: Resource groups, management groups na tags ni bure.

en.line: Estimate before you deploy with the pricing calculator. Track what you actually spend with Cost Management. Label resources with tags.
en.simple: The pricing calculator estimates costs before you build anything, and nothing is created or charged. Microsoft Cost Management shows your real spending, lets you set budgets and sends alerts. Tags are name and value labels, like Department = Finance, that let you group costs and manage resources.
en.africa: The pricing calculator is like asking a fundi for a quote before building. Cost Management is your monthly M-Pesa statement with a spending alert. Tags are the coloured labels on stock that show which shop they belong to.
en.breaks: Resources do not inherit tags from their resource group automatically. You need Azure Policy for that.
en.exam: Estimate before deploying: pricing calculator. Track and alert on real spending: Cost Management. Group the bill by department without moving resources: tags. The TCO calculator has been retired.

check.q: You want to see costs by department without moving any resources. What do you use?
check.why: Tags group costs without changing where resources live.

sw.line: Kadiria kabla ya kusambaza kwa pricing calculator. Fuatilia unachotumia kweli kwa Cost Management. Weka lebo kwa tags.
sw.simple: Pricing calculator hukadiria gharama kabla ya kujenga chochote, na hakuna kinachoundwa wala kulipiwa. Microsoft Cost Management huonyesha matumizi yako halisi, hukuruhusu kuweka bajeti na hutuma tahadhari. Tags ni lebo za jina na thamani, kama Department = Finance, zinazokuruhusu kupanga gharama na kusimamia rasilimali.
sw.africa: Pricing calculator ni kama kumwomba fundi bei kabla ya kujenga. Cost Management ni taarifa yako ya kila mwezi ya M-Pesa yenye tahadhari ya matumizi. Tags ni lebo za rangi kwenye bidhaa zinazoonyesha ni za duka gani.
sw.breaks: Rasilimali hazirithi tags kutoka resource group yao kiotomatiki. Unahitaji Azure Policy kwa hilo.
sw.exam: Kukadiria kabla ya kusambaza: pricing calculator. Kufuatilia na kupata tahadhari ya matumizi halisi: Cost Management. Kupanga bili kwa idara bila kuhamisha rasilimali: tags. TCO calculator imestaafishwa.

check.q: Unataka kuona gharama kwa idara bila kuhamisha rasilimali. Unatumia nini?
check.why: Tags hupanga gharama bila kubadilisha mahali rasilimali zilipo.

en.line: Azure Policy controls what resources may look like. Resource locks stop accidental deletion or change. Purview governs your data.
en.simple: Azure Policy creates rules that control or audit resources, such as allowing only certain regions, and can block or fix non-compliant ones. A group of policies is an initiative. A Delete lock stops deletion, and a ReadOnly lock stops any change. Locks apply even to Owners until removed. Microsoft Purview discovers, classifies and tracks your data across many places.
en.africa: Policy is the market rule that every stall must sell only approved goods. A lock is a padlock on the store room so nobody throws stock away by mistake, even the owner, until the padlock is removed.
en.breaks: A lock protects against mistakes, not against someone who has the right to remove it on purpose.
en.exam: Policy is what resources may look like. RBAC is what people may do. Locks stop deletion or change. Purview governs your DATA.

check.q: You must stop anyone, even an Owner, from accidentally deleting a resource group. What do you use?
check.why: A Delete lock blocks deletion whatever the role.

sw.line: Azure Policy hudhibiti jinsi rasilimali zinavyoweza kuwa. Resource locks huzuia kufuta au kubadilisha kwa bahati mbaya. Purview hutawala data yako.
sw.simple: Azure Policy huunda sheria zinazodhibiti au kukagua rasilimali, kama kuruhusu maeneo fulani tu, na inaweza kuzuia au kurekebisha zisizofuata sheria. Kundi la policies ni initiative. Delete lock huzuia kufuta, na ReadOnly lock huzuia mabadiliko yoyote. Locks hutumika hata kwa Owners hadi ziondolewe. Microsoft Purview hugundua, huainisha na kufuatilia data yako sehemu nyingi.
sw.africa: Policy ni sheria ya soko kwamba kila kibanda kiuze bidhaa zilizoidhinishwa tu. Lock ni kufuli kwenye stoo ili mtu asitupe bidhaa kwa bahati mbaya, hata mwenye duka, hadi kufuli liondolewe.
sw.breaks: Lock hulinda dhidi ya makosa, si dhidi ya mtu mwenye haki ya kuliondoa kwa makusudi.
sw.exam: Policy ni jinsi rasilimali zinavyoweza kuwa. RBAC ni kile watu wanaweza kufanya. Locks huzuia kufuta au kubadilisha. Purview hutawala DATA yako.

check.q: Lazima uzuie mtu yeyote, hata Owner, asifute resource group kwa bahati mbaya. Unatumia nini?
check.why: Delete lock huzuia kufuta bila kujali jukumu.

en.line: The Service Trust Portal is where you get Microsoft's security, privacy and compliance documents.
en.simple: The Service Trust Portal, at servicetrust.microsoft.com, offers audit reports and compliance documents about how Microsoft protects data. Some content needs a work or school account and acceptance of a non-disclosure agreement.
en.africa: It is like asking a supplier for their certificates and inspection reports before you trust them with your goods.
en.breaks: The portal shows Microsoft's own compliance. It does not check whether your resources are compliant. That is Azure Policy or Defender for Cloud.
en.exam: Where do I get Microsoft's compliance and audit reports? The Service Trust Portal. Not Purview, not Advisor.

check.q: Where can you download Microsoft's audit and compliance reports?
check.why: The Service Trust Portal publishes these documents.

sw.line: Service Trust Portal ni mahali unapopata nyaraka za usalama, faragha na uzingatiaji za Microsoft.
sw.simple: Service Trust Portal, kwenye servicetrust.microsoft.com, inatoa ripoti za ukaguzi na nyaraka za uzingatiaji kuhusu jinsi Microsoft inavyolinda data. Maudhui mengine yanahitaji akaunti ya kazi au shule na kukubali makubaliano ya kutofichua.
sw.africa: Ni kama kumwomba msambazaji vyeti vyake na ripoti za ukaguzi kabla ya kumwamini na bidhaa zako.
sw.breaks: Portal inaonyesha uzingatiaji wa Microsoft wenyewe. Haikagui kama rasilimali zako zinazingatia sheria. Hiyo ni Azure Policy au Defender for Cloud.
sw.exam: Ninapata wapi ripoti za uzingatiaji na ukaguzi za Microsoft? Service Trust Portal. Si Purview, si Advisor.

check.q: Unaweza kupakua wapi ripoti za ukaguzi na uzingatiaji za Microsoft?
check.why: Service Trust Portal huchapisha nyaraka hizi.

en.line: You manage Azure with the portal in a browser, with commands in the CLI or PowerShell, and you can reach outside Azure with Azure Arc.
en.simple: The Azure portal is a web console with a graphical interface. Cloud Shell runs commands in your browser with nothing to install. Azure CLI uses Bash-style commands that start with az, and Azure PowerShell uses cmdlets. Azure Arc lets you manage servers and Kubernetes outside Azure, on-premises or in other clouds, with Azure tools.
en.africa: The portal is the shop counter where you point and choose. The CLI is giving the shopkeeper a written list so the same order can be repeated every week. Azure Arc is managing your branches in other towns from head office.
en.breaks: The CLI and PowerShell do the same jobs. The difference is the command style, not the power.
en.exam: Linux admins who want Bash: Azure CLI. Run commands from the browser with nothing installed: Cloud Shell. Manage on-premises or other clouds from Azure: Azure Arc.

check.q: Your team wants to manage servers in another cloud using Azure tools. What do you use?
check.why: Azure Arc projects outside resources into Azure management.

sw.line: Unasimamia Azure kwa portal kwenye kivinjari, kwa amri kwenye CLI au PowerShell, na unaweza kufikia nje ya Azure kwa Azure Arc.
sw.simple: Azure portal ni dashibodi ya wavuti yenye kiolesura cha picha. Cloud Shell huendesha amri kwenye kivinjari chako bila kusakinisha chochote. Azure CLI hutumia amri za mtindo wa Bash zinazoanza na az, na Azure PowerShell hutumia cmdlets. Azure Arc hukuruhusu kusimamia seva na Kubernetes nje ya Azure, on-premises au kwenye wingu zingine, kwa zana za Azure.
sw.africa: Portal ni kaunta ya duka ambapo unaonyesha na kuchagua. CLI ni kumpa muuzaji orodha iliyoandikwa ili oda ileile irudiwe kila wiki. Azure Arc ni kusimamia matawi yako kwenye miji mingine kutoka ofisi kuu.
sw.breaks: CLI na PowerShell hufanya kazi zilezile. Tofauti ni mtindo wa amri, si nguvu.
sw.exam: Wasimamizi wa Linux wanaotaka Bash: Azure CLI. Kuendesha amri kwenye kivinjari bila kusakinisha: Cloud Shell. Kusimamia on-premises au wingu zingine kutoka Azure: Azure Arc.

check.q: Timu yako inataka kusimamia seva kwenye wingu jingine kwa zana za Azure. Unatumia nini?
check.why: Azure Arc huleta rasilimali za nje kwenye usimamizi wa Azure.

en.line: Azure Resource Manager is the service every request goes through. ARM templates and Bicep describe your setup as code.
en.simple: Every request from the portal, CLI, PowerShell or SDKs goes through Azure Resource Manager (ARM), which checks who you are and what you may do, then passes it on. Infrastructure as code means writing your setup in files. ARM templates are declarative JSON: you describe the end result and ARM builds it, in the right order, the same way every time. Bicep is a simpler language for the same job.
en.africa: An ARM template is like a building plan from an architect. Give the same plan to any fundi and you get the same house every time.
en.breaks: Unlike a building plan, you can redeploy a template many times and it only changes what is different.
en.exam: ARM is the service. An ARM template is the JSON file. Deploy the same environment again and again: ARM templates or Bicep.

check.q: Which service handles every create and update request in Azure, whatever tool you use?
check.why: All requests go through Azure Resource Manager.

sw.line: Azure Resource Manager ni huduma ambayo kila ombi hupitia. ARM templates na Bicep huelezea mpangilio wako kama msimbo.
sw.simple: Kila ombi kutoka portal, CLI, PowerShell au SDK hupitia Azure Resource Manager (ARM), ambayo hukagua wewe ni nani na unaweza kufanya nini, kisha huipitisha. Infrastructure as code ni kuandika mpangilio wako kwenye mafaili. ARM templates ni JSON ya kutangaza: unaelezea matokeo ya mwisho na ARM huyajenga, kwa mpangilio sahihi, kwa njia ileile kila mara. Bicep ni lugha rahisi zaidi kwa kazi hiyohiyo.
sw.africa: ARM template ni kama ramani ya jengo kutoka kwa msanifu. Mpe fundi yeyote ramani ileile na utapata nyumba ileile kila mara.
sw.breaks: Tofauti na ramani ya jengo, unaweza kusambaza template mara nyingi na inabadilisha tu kilicho tofauti.
sw.exam: ARM ni huduma. ARM template ni faili ya JSON. Kusambaza mazingira yaleyale tena na tena: ARM templates au Bicep.

check.q: Huduma gani hushughulikia kila ombi la kuunda na kusasisha kwenye Azure, bila kujali zana unayotumia?
check.why: Maombi yote hupitia Azure Resource Manager.

en.line: Advisor gives advice, Service Health tells you when Azure itself has problems, and Azure Monitor collects your logs and metrics.
en.simple: Azure Advisor gives personalised recommendations in five areas: reliability, security, performance, operational excellence and cost. Azure Service Health shows outages, planned maintenance and health advisories for the services and regions you use, and Resource Health checks one resource. Azure Monitor collects logs and metrics, Log Analytics lets you query them, alerts notify you, and Application Insights watches web apps.
en.africa: Advisor is the experienced shop owner who tells you how to save money. Service Health is the radio announcement that the main road is closed. Azure Monitor is the CCTV and sales records of your own shop.
en.breaks: Advisor only recommends. It does not change anything until you act.
en.exam: Advice: Advisor. Is Azure down for me: Service Health. Is this one VM OK: Resource Health. Logs, metrics and alerts: Azure Monitor. Act before retirements and breaking changes: health advisories.

check.q: Which service gives recommendations to cut cost and improve security?
check.why: Advisor gives recommendations in five categories, including cost and security.

sw.line: Advisor hutoa ushauri, Service Health hukuambia Azure yenyewe ina matatizo, na Azure Monitor hukusanya logs na metrics zako.
sw.simple: Azure Advisor hutoa mapendekezo binafsi kwenye maeneo matano: kuaminika, usalama, utendaji, ubora wa uendeshaji na gharama. Azure Service Health huonyesha hitilafu, matengenezo yaliyopangwa na tahadhari za afya kwa huduma na maeneo unayotumia, na Resource Health hukagua rasilimali moja. Azure Monitor hukusanya logs na metrics, Log Analytics hukuruhusu kuziuliza maswali, alerts hukujulisha, na Application Insights hufuatilia programu za wavuti.
sw.africa: Advisor ni mwenye duka mzoefu anayekuambia jinsi ya kuokoa pesa. Service Health ni tangazo la redio kwamba barabara kuu imefungwa. Azure Monitor ni CCTV na kumbukumbu za mauzo za duka lako.
sw.breaks: Advisor hupendekeza tu. Haibadilishi chochote hadi uchukue hatua.
sw.exam: Ushauri: Advisor. Je, Azure imeharibika kwangu: Service Health. Je, VM hii moja iko sawa: Resource Health. Logs, metrics na alerts: Azure Monitor. Kuchukua hatua kabla ya kustaafishwa na mabadiliko makubwa: health advisories.

check.q: Huduma gani hutoa mapendekezo ya kupunguza gharama na kuboresha usalama?
check.why: Advisor hutoa mapendekezo kwenye makundi matano, ikiwemo gharama na usalama.
